By: Jana Marx | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Tonight on Carte Blanche we're following a Pretoria-based antivax activist's journey and evolvement from social media tirades to being arrested for conspiracy to commit murder.

Unique Selling Point:
It’s a Carte Blanche exclusive - the inside scoop on an alleged conspiracy to “take out” the opponents of one of Pretoria’s most vocal antivax activists.

Summary:
It’s not every day we get the inside scoop on an alleged conspiracy to take people out... and it was certainly the last thing we expected when we started looking into grand claims published online by Pretoria-based anti-vaxx activist, Schalk van der Merwe... But our paths soon crossed with a undercover hitman and we followed a police sting operation till the the arrest of this man and his wife.. Bongani investigates.

Further information:
This is a story with many twists and many turns - a bit of a long-winding road. We introudce Schalk van der Merwe, activist, lawyer, business consultant and businessman… Together with his wife, Leoni, they have risen to FB stardom… Saviours of those fighting against mandatory vaccinations in the workplace. Van der Merwe offers a range of services, including legal advice on employees’ constitutional rights when it comes to vaccine mandates. There were complaints that he was taking money, but people were not getting the results. It was even alleged he was operating illegally, posing as an attorney. He calls himself a lawyer - treading a very grey area in the law. It also became clear that he was lying about all his so-called "successes" - lying about saving people's jobs and taking on big, listed companies. We thought this was the story...And then we got a call from Dean van Coller, an ex-convict turned anti-crime activist, that was contracted by Schalk and Leoni to take out the couples enemies. What started as borderline illegal practices, escalated to conspiracy to commit murder.

Press Release:


Cloak and Daggers
It’s a Carte Blanche exclusive - the inside scoop on an alleged conspiracy to eliminate the opponents of one of Pretoria’s most vocal anti-vax activists. With an estimated 100,000 followers online, it’s the story of man allegedly treading a fine line: freely dishing out legal advice and claiming victories against large, listed companies while also charging money for services the CCMA offers for free. But has he gone too far? As allegations of a hit list surface, the hired hitman-turned-undercover-police-informant reveals how online tirades have culminated in a charge of conspiracy to commit murder.
Producers: Jana Marx & Stenette Grosskopf | Presenter: Bongani Bingwa
EMBED TRAILER


Script:


UPSOUND POLICE “Goeiemiddag, goeiemiddag…”

V/O This is no ordinary social meeting at a restaurant…

Visuals of Schalk getting up - 1:16 and looking at the cops (before being cuffed)

UPSOUND POLICE “Sal julle tweetjies ons begelei na die polisiestasie toe, asseblief?”

V/O It’s the culmination of 2 months of negotiations between a husband and wife… and a man posing as a hitman as part of a police sting operation…

UPSOUND SCHALK “Dean, waaroor gaan dit nou?”

LINK So, how did we get here? Well, this is a story with many twists and many turns - a bit of a long-winding road. So let’s go back to the beginning.

V/O Meet Schalk van der Merwe, activist, lawyer, business consultant and businessman… Visuals of his various platforms - FB and Telegram

Upsound Schalk “Cheers for the day.”

V/O Together with his wife, Leoni van der Merwe they have risen to FB stardom… Saviours of those fighting against mandatory vaccinations in the workplace…

UPSOUND Leoni “...en dit is nou veral die employers wat so verkeerde inligting kry…”


V/O Van der Merwe offers a range of services, including legal advice on employees’ constitutional rights when it comes to vaccine mandates.

UPSOUND Schalk “You cannot mandatory force a person to vax.”

V/O Pricing starts at R850 - an “administration fee”…

LINK Van der Merwe has been on our radar since January. There were complaints that he was taking money, but people were not getting the results. It was even alleged he was operating illegally, posing as an attorney. He calls himself a lawyer - treading a very grey area in the law.

V/O According to the Legal Practice Council only an admitted legal practitioner can call themselves an attorney. A lawyer has legal training, but is not registered with the LPC … It’s a subtle difference that many of Van der Merwe’s followers may not be aware of…

UPSOUND Marianne “Ek was aanvanklik baie baie opgewonde want hier’s iemand wat bietjie gaan opkom vir mense…” STRAP: Marianne Rheeder Benadé

V/O As the admin of anti-vaxx support groups on Facebook and Telegram, Marianne Rheeder Benadé believed that Van der Merwe was their man of the hour…

UPSOUND Marianne “Ek het gedink hier is nou ons persoon wat die kwalifikasies het, hy het ook die finansiële backup om mense hof toe te vat.”

UPSOUND SCHALK …saving literally thousands of jobs, taking hundreds of cases to CCMA…

V/O But according to the CCMA by mid- February this year they were aware of only 125 Covid vaccine cases across South Africa and could not confirm how many of these, were referred by Van der Merwe.

LINK Vax versus antivax: This story is not about that. But rather it’s about a man who has a significant and vocal social media following. And he makes some wild promises… But can he deliver?

Upsound Tony 0:47 “So if you purport to be an expert in, for example, the area of workplace vaccination law, then that's okay. But then you need to ensure that you are.”

V/O Tony Healy is a labour law consultant, and he says that Van der Merwe’s legal advice seems to be disregarding important parts of our legislation.

Upsound Tony I also see that he has standard correspondence which he recommends those who object vaccination present to their employers. And it is incompetent in many ways.

7:49: Explain?

7:51 Well, for example, He states that the human rights contained in chapter two of our Constitution cannot be suspended under any circumstances. Now, if you read chapter two, it says very clearly that they can be limited in terms of our Constitution.

VO - ROR1 (email) When we asked Van der Merwe about his so-called successes he simply responded that all his dealings with clients and followers are highly confidential, and he would not reveal what happens behind closed doors…

VO Van der Merwe also bragged about taking the anti-mandate fight to major companies over their internal vaccination policies… These include mobile communications company Rain Telecoms, pharmaceutical giant, Dischem… …Even one of the world’s largest Platinum producers…

UPSOUND SCHALK Sibanye Stillwater I know them very very well from many years of dealing with them….

LINK Tough talk, but is it true? Sibanye Stillwater says they had no dealings with him. Dis-Chem says no contact with him whatsoever. Rain - never heard of him. Discovery says there was no legal challenge - either by Schalk himself or any legal representative.

UPSOUND Marianne Toe het ek begin kyk na sy videos en ek het begin dink by myself maar ek het nog nêrens regtig suksesse gesien nie…

V/O Marianne then decided to ask Van der Merwe for proof of his so-called victories…

UPSOUND Marianne 3:27 “Dit was seker so 2 minute daarna, toe was Schalk op my groep waarop hy my toe aanval, beledig slegsê, dreig. Hy het my probeer intimideer. Hy het vir my gesê: ‘Jy sal maar oor jou skouer moet kyk van nou af’.”

LINK For a lawyer, Schalk van der Merwe doesn’t like questions. If you ask anything about his expertise or his background, he lashes out at his followers, potential clients and even media houses.

V/O Abbygail van Wyk is a legal practitioner representing various clients in ongoing litigation against Van der Merwe.

UPSOUND Abbygail 06:38 He threatened publicly to report me to the LPC, he stated publicly that I’m an unethical and dishonest attorney,…

Bongani: Has he gone beyond just threatening people on Social media?

Yes, he has.

13:34 My client’s female candidate attorney was assaulted - physcially assaulted and her property maliciously damaged when she attempted to serve court documentation on Mr VDM at his residential address.

VO ROR According to Van Wyk, Van der Merwe pleaded not guilty in this ongoing court case against him.

VO With questions about the services he offers, the money he charges, the disgruntled clients AND allegations of intimidation and harassment, we approached him for an interview.

LINK But then the story took a dramatic turn. And that’s when we met Dean van Coller, a man who spent almost half a decade in prison for murder.

UPSOUND Dean “Ek het nie betrokke geraak by Schalk-hulle nie. Schalk-hulle het betrokke geraak by my …” Strap Dean van Coller, Justice-League Africa

V/O When they met, Van Coller had served six years for killing a former business partner but now reformed, he wanted to produce a documentary on farm murders.

Their shared political ideology formed the foundation of their relationship… When Covid hit their film was put on the back burner. But their association did not end…

LINK On the 3rd of January this year, Van der Merwe and his wife, Leoni, went to Sodwana on the KZN North coast - supposedly on holiday. But it became very clear to Van Coller that they had a different agenda…

VO They presumably chose Sodwana because that’s where Van Coller lives…

UPSOUND Dean “Ek het ‘n vermoede gehad hoekom hulle my kom sien het. Want Leoni het voor dit gevra of ek dit of dan kan doen… Nie pertinent moord nie, maar of ek kan help om die ou se bene te breek en die ou dit te doen… om mense net bietjie skrik op die lyf te jaag…”

V/O Van Coller alleges that this time the request was direct - They both had personal enemies from their past that they wanted to do away with.

UPSOUND Dean “Toe het sy vir my pertinent gevra, jy weet, is jy bereid om dit te doen? Nou.. in alle normale omstandighede gaan jy obviously jou rug draai daarteen, maar jy moet ook verstaan, ek kan nie net my rug draai en dit los nie want sy sal iemand anderste nader.”

V/O Van Coller now runs an organisation that sometimes assists in police investigations. He decided to play along. And for the next six weeks emails and text messages were exchanged …

UPSOUND Dean “In al haar kommunikasies het sy op ‘n stadium het sy Schalk ingetrek toe dit kom by die geldsake. So, is hy deel daarvan? Definitief. Is hy deel van die beplanning? Definitief…”

V/O He claims that on the 18th of February the Van Der Merwes gave him the official go-ahead.

UPSOUND Dean “Ons het toe ooreengekom op die ou end van die dag vir R10,000 per persoon… Daar is toe ook ooreengekom by wyse van hoe dit gedoen moet word. Daar is ook ooreengekom van hoe die betaling sal geskiet en wanneer die lys name beskikbaar sou gegee word.”

LINK And that is how we got to this meeting at a restaurant in Pretoria North where the deal was sealed; the money exchanged and where the police were waiting in the wings.

V/O Van der Merwe and his wife were cuffed and escorted to the police station.

I was curious to know more about the actual arrest, so I arranged to meet Van Coller online…

UPSOUND Arrest 8:02 What what happened that day of the arrest?

8:22 He was he was flabbergasted when when the police arrived on the scene, and and he was really dumbstruck as to what was going on the he didn't, for one moment actually think that I'm a good guy…

9:00 How many people you're supposed to take out?

9:04
It's more than one.

V/O They have since been released on bail. A lawyer for the Van der Merwes told us that because Mr Van der Merwe is now ill and seeking medical attention, he is not able to respond to the allegations against him.

UPSOUND SCHALK There is only 1 charge against us, conspiracy to commit murder, it’s only a category 2 offence and not even deemed a serious offence.

V/O On Friday night the couple denied the existence of a hit list and told their followers they are currently in a place of safety, as they fear for their lives.

UPSOUND Leoni: “It is con-spi-ra-cy to commit murder.”
Schalk, laughing: “Conspiracy, yes. There is not a body.”

UPSOUND Marianne Toe het ek begin kyk na sy videos en ek het begin dink by myself maar ek het nog nêrens regtig suksesse gesien nie… V/O Marianne then decided to ask Van der Merwe for proof of his so-called victories… UPSOUND Marianne 3:27 “Dit was seker so 2 minute daarna, toe was Schalk op my groep waarop hy my toe aanval, beledig slegsê, dreig. Hy het my probeer intimideer. Hy het vir my gesê: ‘Jy sal maar oor jou skouer moet kyk van nou af’.” LINK For a lawyer, Schalk van der Merwe doesn’t like questions. If you ask anything about his expertise or his background, he lashes out at his followers, potential clients and even media houses. V/O Abbygail van Wyk is a legal practitioner representing various clients in ongoing litigation against Van der Merwe. UPSOUND Abbygail 06:38 He threatened publicly to report me to the LPC, he stated publicly that I’m an unethical and dishonest attorney,… Bongani: Has he gone beyond just threatening people on Social media? Yes, he has. 13:34 My client’s female candidate attorney was assaulted - physcially assaulted and her property maliciously damaged when she attempted to serve court documentation on Mr VDM at his residential address. VO ROR According to Van Wyk, Van der Merwe pleaded not guilty in this ongoing court case against him. VO With questions about the services he offers, the money he charges, the disgruntled clients AND allegations of intimidation and harassment, we approached him for an interview. LINK But then the story took a dramatic turn. And that’s when we met Dean van Coller, a man who spent almost half a decade in prison for murder. UPSOUND Dean “Ek het nie betrokke geraak by Schalk-hulle nie. Schalk-hulle het betrokke geraak by my …” Strap Dean van Coller, Justice-League Africa V/O When they met, Van Coller had served six years for killing a former business partner but now reformed, he wanted to produce a documentary on farm murders. Their shared political ideology formed the foundation of their relationship… When Covid hit their film was put on the back burner. But their association did not end… LINK On the 3rd of January this year, Van der Merwe and his wife, Leoni, went to Sodwana on the KZN North coast - supposedly on holiday. But it became very clear to Van Coller that they had a different agenda… VO They presumably chose Sodwana because that’s where Van Coller lives… UPSOUND Dean “Ek het ‘n vermoede gehad hoekom hulle my kom sien het. Want Leoni het voor dit gevra of ek dit of dan kan doen… Nie pertinent moord nie, maar of ek kan help om die ou se bene te breek en die ou dit te doen… om mense net bietjie skrik op die lyf te jaag…” V/O Van Coller alleges that this time the request was direct - They both had personal enemies from their past that they wanted to do away with. UPSOUND Dean “Toe het sy vir my pertinent gevra, jy weet, is jy bereid om dit te doen? Nou.. in alle normale omstandighede gaan jy obviously jou rug draai daarteen, maar jy moet ook verstaan, ek kan nie net my rug draai en dit los nie want sy sal iemand anderste nader.” V/O Van Coller now runs an organisation that sometimes assists in police investigations. He decided to play along. And for the next six weeks emails and text messages were exchanged … UPSOUND Dean “In al haar kommunikasies het sy op ‘n stadium het sy Schalk ingetrek toe dit kom by die geldsake. So, is hy deel daarvan? Definitief. Is hy deel van die beplanning? Definitief…” V/O He claims that on the 18th of February the Van Der Merwes gave him the official go-ahead. UPSOUND Dean “Ons het toe ooreengekom op die ou end van die dag vir R10,000 per persoon… Daar is toe ook ooreengekom by wyse van hoe dit gedoen moet word. Daar is ook ooreengekom van hoe die betaling sal geskiet en wanneer die lys name beskikbaar sou gegee word.” LINK And that is how we got to this meeting at a restaurant in Pretoria North where the deal was sealed; the money exchanged and where the police were waiting in the wings. V/O Van der Merwe and his wife were cuffed and escorted to the police station. I was curious to know more about the actual arrest, so I arranged to meet Van Coller online… UPSOUND Arrest 8:02 What what happened that day of the arrest? 8:22 He was he was flabbergasted when when the police arrived on the scene, and and he was really dumbstruck as to what was going on the he didn't, for one moment actually think that I'm a good guy… 9:00 How many people you're supposed to take out? 9:04 It's more than one. V/O They have since been released on bail. A lawyer for the Van der Merwes told us that because Mr Van der Merwe is now ill and seeking medical attention, he is not able to respond to the allegations against him. UPSOUND SCHALK There is only 1 charge against us, conspiracy to commit murder, it’s only a category 2 offence and not even deemed a serious offence. V/O On Friday night the couple denied the existence of a hit list and told their followers they are currently in a place of safety, as they fear for their lives. UPSOUND Leoni: “It is con-spi-ra-cy to commit murder.” Schalk, laughing: “Conspiracy, yes. There is not a body.”

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Tonight on Carte Blanche we're following a Pretoria-based antivax activist's journey and evolvement from social media tirades to being arrested for conspiracy to commit murder.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: It’s a Carte Blanche exclusive - the inside scoop on an alleged conspiracy to “take out” the opponents of one of Pretoria’s most vocal antivax activists.
metadata.Summary: It’s not every day we get the inside scoop on an alleged conspiracy to take people out... and it was certainly the last thing we expected when we started looking into grand claims published online by Pretoria-based anti-vaxx activist, Schalk van der Merwe... But our paths soon crossed with a undercover hitman and we followed a police sting operation till the the arrest of this man and his wife.. Bongani investigates.
metadata.Further information: This is a story with many twists and many turns - a bit of a long-winding road. We introudce Schalk van der Merwe, activist, lawyer, business consultant and businessman… Together with his wife, Leoni, they have risen to FB stardom… Saviours of those fighting against mandatory vaccinations in the workplace. Van der Merwe offers a range of services, including legal advice on employees’ constitutional rights when it comes to vaccine mandates. There were complaints that he was taking money, but people were not getting the results. It was even alleged he was operating illegally, posing as an attorney. He calls himself a lawyer - treading a very grey area in the law. It also became clear that he was lying about all his so-called "successes" - lying about saving people's jobs and taking on big, listed companies. We thought this was the story...And then we got a call from Dean van Coller, an ex-convict turned anti-crime activist, that was contracted by Schalk and Leoni to take out the couples enemies. What started as borderline illegal practices, escalated to conspiracy to commit murder.
